title: Construct initial molecular models
action: Build the four molecular complexes [M(trans-di[benzo]porphyrazine)(F)2] (M = Fe, Co, Ni, Cu) using a molecular builder or by scripting approximate geometries based on the known ligand connectivity and standard bond lengths. Save coordinate files for each complex.
description: Prepare initial Cartesian coordinates for the four target complexes to serve as starting points for DFT optimization.

title: DFT geometry optimization and vibrational frequency analysis
action: For each complex, run gas-phase DFT calculations at the OPBE/TZVP level using ORCA. Perform geometry optimization and compute harmonic vibrational frequencies. Evaluate all plausible spin multiplicities to compare total energies and determine the ground electronic state. Save optimized coordinates and the ORCA output files.
description: The core computational step that yields optimized geometries, vibrational frequencies, total electronic energies, and identifies the ground spin state.

title: Extract metal–ligand bond lengths
action: From the optimized geometries of the ground-state complexes, extract the M–N and M–F bond lengths. Write them to step_01_bond_lengths.csv.
description: Tabulate the six metal–ligand bond lengths (M–N1 to M–N4, M–F1, M–F2) for each metal.
output_schema: CSV with columns: metal, bond, length. metal: Fe/Co/Ni/Cu. bond: M-N1, M-N2, M-N3, M-N4, M-F1, M-F2. length: float (pm). 24 rows total.

title: Extract planarity indicators
action: Compute the sum of the N–M–N bond angles in the MN4 chelate site, and the sum of bond angles in each of the six-membered chelate rings. Write the results to step_04_planarity_checks.csv.
description: Provide the total angle sums that indicate planarity of the chelate site and the six-membered chelate rings.
output_schema: CSV with columns: metal, site, sum_angles_deg. metal: Fe/Co/Ni/Cu. site: one of 'MN4', 'chelate_ring1', 'chelate_ring2'. sum_angles_deg: float. 12 rows.

title: Determine ground-state spin multiplicities
action: Identify the spin multiplicity of the lowest-energy electronic state for each complex. Write the results to step_03_spin_states.csv.
description: Report the ground-state spin multiplicity (1, 2, 3, or 4) for each metal complex.
output_schema: CSV with columns: metal, ground_state_multiplicity. metal: Fe/Co/Ni/Cu. multiplicity: integer (1=singlet,2=doublet,3=triplet,4=quartet). 4 rows.

title: Compute thermodynamic formation parameters
action: Using the total electronic energy and vibrational frequency data from the DFT calculation, compute the standard enthalpy (ΔH°f,298), standard Gibbs energy (ΔG°f,298), and standard entropy (S°f,298) of formation for each complex. Write the results to step_02_thermodynamics.csv.
description: Provide the formation thermodynamic properties as derived from the gas-phase DFT calculation.
output_schema: CSV with columns: metal, delta_H, delta_G, S. metal: Fe/Co/Ni/Cu. delta_H and delta_G in kJ/mol (float). S in J/mol·K (float). 4 rows.
